evals.prompt: 看看这个仓库现在有哪些 open 的 PR
evals.expected_output: Runs gh pr list directly (read-only, no bootstrap first) with --json fields and an explicit -L limit.

evals.prompt: PR 123 的 review 评论都说了什么？
evals.expected_output: Reads review threads through gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/123/comments, not only gh pr view --comments.

evals.prompt: 搜一下 star 最多的 Rust TUI 开源项目
evals.expected_output: Uses gh search repos with qualifiers and structured output.

evals.prompt: 给 cli/cli 提个 issue，标题「--jq 示例有误」，正文我一会儿给你
evals.expected_output: Shows the target repo and content before creating; the command carries --title and --body.
Treats gh pr merge as a high-risk write and asks the user to confirm before running it.

evals.prompt: 看下本地改了哪些文件，帮我 commit 一下
evals.expected_output: Pure local git status / commit with no GitHub remote step.

evals.prompt: git rebase 冲突了，这几个冲突块怎么解
evals.expected_output: Local conflict resolution; no gh command.

evals.prompt: 在 GitLab 上给这个项目开一个 merge request
evals.expected_output: GitLab is a different remote; gh does not apply.
